purpose: Protocol qualification only; rows are excluded from fleet efficacy and adoption reports.

cases.prompt: Read the named fixture file with bounded output and report its shape.
Use span search to locate the relevant symbol before reading a slice.
Read the exact source span identified by the search result.
Run the fixture's declared check; if it fails, use one bounded alternate verification command.
Make the smallest anchored edit required by the fixture specification.
Write the requested fixture artifact and read it back to confirm persistence.
After the fixture mutation, run the project verifier and report its result.
Inspect available capabilities and activate the one required by the fixture.
Create a bounded flat plan for the fixture and keep the plan item statuses explicit.
Update the active flat plan after completing one item.
